package.name: pinkrab_sim
package.description:
Pinkrab in simulation: the UMI loop run end to end in MuJoCo. A Hermit with no arm behind it makes the takes, written in the recorder's own raw format; the same convert turns them into a dataset, and the arm in the same scene runs what was trained on it through the same rollout code. Everything the pipeline does to a take is exercised against poses that are known exactly, and a policy is judged before any arm is handed to it.
Built on pinkrab_mujoco's scene. The safety gate and the driver must not depend on this package: it takes in a policy's training stack (torch, lerobot), and they run on the robot's host.
